F00.plain_language: The realized ICD family identifies dementia in Alzheimer disease.

F01.plain_language: The realized ICD family identifies vascular dementia.

F02.plain_language: The realized ICD family identifies dementia in another disease classified elsewhere.

F03.plain_language: The realized ICD family identifies unspecified dementia.

F10.plain_language: Alcohol use is part of this diagnostic family itself; this is not merely a statistical alcohol-risk association.

G30.plain_language: The realized ICD family identifies Alzheimer disease; dementia/Alzheimer state is therefore present in the simulated death record rather than inferred from prevalence.

G31.2.plain_language: The diagnosis itself attributes degeneration of the nervous system to alcohol.

G40.51.plain_language: This Finnish detailed mortality code identifies epilepsy attributed to alcohol.

G62.1.plain_language: The diagnosis itself identifies alcoholic polyneuropathy.

G72.1.plain_language: The diagnosis itself identifies alcoholic myopathy.

I42.6.plain_language: The diagnosis itself identifies alcoholic cardiomyopathy.

K29.2.plain_language: The diagnosis itself identifies alcoholic gastritis.

K70.plain_language: Alcohol is part of this liver-disease diagnosis family itself.

K70.0.plain_language: The realized ICD code identifies alcoholic fatty liver.

K70.1.plain_language: The realized ICD code identifies alcoholic hepatitis.

K70.2.plain_language: The realized ICD code identifies alcoholic fibrosis or sclerosis of the liver.

K70.3.plain_language: The realized ICD code identifies alcoholic cirrhosis of the liver.

K70.4.plain_language: The realized ICD code identifies alcoholic hepatic failure.

K70.9.plain_language: The realized ICD code identifies alcoholic liver disease without a more specific K70 subtype.

K85.2.plain_language: The diagnosis itself identifies alcohol-induced acute pancreatitis.

K86.0.plain_language: The diagnosis itself identifies alcohol-induced chronic pancreatitis.
